name: EP Exporter for Contact Form 7 (CF7)
author: EstudioPatagon

sections.description:
EP Exporter for Contact Form 7 is a powerful yet lightweight plugin that allows you to export Contact Form 7 submissions with advanced features and smart filtering options.

Unlike basic export plugins, Our exporter provides intelligent data management and export capabilities designed for modern WordPress websites without adding any load to your website.

Features

  • Smart Export Options – Multiple formats and filtering
  • Advanced Filtering – Export by date range, form, or specific fields
  • Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance (no bloated code, it loads only when required)
  • User-Friendly Interface – Clean and intuitive dashboard, similar to any WordPress admin page.
  • Export Formats – CSV
  • Bulk Operations – Handle large datasets efficiently
  • Developer Friendly – Well organized code

Why Choose our Exporter?

  • Performance Focused – Built with speed and efficiency in mind
  • Modern Interface – Clean, professional design
  • Smart Features – Goes beyond basic export functionality
  • Regular Updates – Maintained by EstudioPatagon team
  • Professional Support – Backed by web development experts

About EstudioPatagon

Created by EstudioPatagon
sections.installation:
1. Download and extract plugin files to wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin interface
  3. Go to CF7 Exports in your admin menu
  4. Start exporting your Contact Form 7 data!
sections.faq:
Does this work with all Contact Form 7 versions?

Yes, EP Exporter is compatible with Contact Form 7 version 4.8 and above.

Can I export data from multiple forms at once?

Yes, our bulk export feature allows you to select and export from multiple forms simultaneously.

Is my data secure during export?

Absolutely. All exports are processed securely and temporarily. We follow WordPress security best practices.

Can I schedule automatic exports?

The free version includes manual exports. Automatic scheduling features are planned for future updates.
